create_shape_vae_model: create a ShapeVAE model for 3D mesh generation from latent codes
run_latents2mesh: run latents2mesh to convert VAE latent tensors into 3D mesh vertices and faces
enable_flashvdm_decoder: enable FlashVDM decoder for faster volume decoding with adaptive KV selection
build_cross_attention_decoder: build a CrossAttentionDecoder that maps query points to occupancy logits
extract_mesh_surface: extract mesh surface from grid logits using marching cubes or differentiable marching cubes
